grammar_focus: 过去完成时(had dictated / had laboured / had been built)、比较级 + than any (other)(表最高级含义)、with 复合结构/独立主格(with the water churned to foam / her flags still flying)、there + 动词 倒装(there came a sudden squall)、be intended to do / order sth to be done(NCE4 无 KS 页,考点由课文结构自取;IP:源为罗伊·桑格斯《The Listener》‘瓦萨号的打捞’一文,内容为瑞典战舰瓦萨号1628首航沉没、1956被发现打捞的公开史实,已用 100% 原创行文复述;沉没场景已净化、不渲染伤亡;题材=海事历史·无害;美语化 harbor/armor;第四册第27课)
scene: 海上最离奇的故事之一,是瓦萨号的故事——十七世纪瑞典的皇家旗舰。她是一艘大帆船。国王古斯塔夫·阿道夫斯,人称‘北方飓风’,当时正处在三十年战争的军事巅峰,亲自规定了她的尺寸与武备。三层炮甲板上要架设六十四门青铜大炮,这艘船本打算在瑞典帝国舰队日渐壮大的声威中担当要角。三年间,造船工匠们呕心沥血,造出一件漂浮的艺术品——比之前任何船都雕饰得更华丽。她高耸的船尾满是雕刻的人物——国王与勇士、美人鱼与奇兽——红金交辉,意在激起所有见者的想象。1628年8月10日,她首航之日,斯德哥尔摩一片沸腾。人们从码头和四周的岛屿上,望着这尤物张帆迎风。停泊的战舰隆隆鸣礼炮,瓦萨号傲然回礼;当她从自己飘散的硝烟中驶出、船首下的水被搅成白沫时,她呈现出市民们从未见过的、更为壮丽的景象。她所有的炮门都敞开着,炮口从里面探出。就在这时,风势转急,突然来了一阵飑。这艘大船怪异地一晃,开始向一侧倾侧,压舱物也随之滑移。负责的军官下令把炮搬向另一侧以扶正船身,可甲板的倾角只是越来越陡。仍旧敞开的下层炮门沉到了水面以下,海水灌了进来。就在这最初的辉煌一刻,本要称霸波罗的海的雄伟瓦萨号,旗帜仍在飘扬,便在她诞生的港湾里沉没了。此后她在海底躺了近三个半世纪,直到1956年被发现、被打捞,才重见天日。

grammar_card.title: 过去完成时 / 比较级 + than any / with 独立结构 / there + 动词 倒装 / be intended·order sth to do
grammar_card.intro: ①过去完成时 had + 过去分词,表‘过去的过去’:had dictated / had laboured。②比较级 + than any (other) 表最高级含义:more richly carved than any ship before her。③with + 名词 + 分词的独立结构:with the water churned to foam。④there + 动词 的全部倒装:there came a squall。⑤be intended to do / order sth to be done。

rows: the king had dictated her size
more carved than any ship before
with the water churned to foam
was intended to rule the Baltic

specialRules.rule: there + come/lie/rise 等动词时全部倒装,动词与后面的真正主语一致:there came a squall。
比较级 + than any other + 单数名词 表‘比其他任何一个都’,等于最高级含义。
美式拼写:harbor(港口,英式 harbour)、armor(装甲,英式 armour)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What happened to the 'Vasa' almost immediately after she was launched?
options: A sudden squall made her list, water poured in, and she sank
She won a great sea battle
She sailed safely to another country
She was captured by an enemy fleet

passage: Among the strangest tales of the sea is the story of the Vasa, the royal flagship of seventeenth-century Sweden. She was a great galleon, and King Gustavus Adolphus, known as 'the Northern Hurricane,' then at the height of his military success in the Thirty Years' War, had himself dictated her measurements and her armament. Triple gun-decks were to mount sixty-four bronze cannon, and the ship was intended to play a leading role in the growing might of Sweden's imperial fleet. For three years her builders had laboured to produce a floating work of art, more richly carved and ornamented than any ship before her. Her high stern was a riot of carved figures — kings and warriors, mermaids and strange beasts — bright with red and gold, meant to stir the imagination of all who saw her. On the tenth of August, 1628, the day of her maiden voyage, Stockholm was in a ferment. From the quays and the surrounding islands the people watched this thing of beauty spread her sails and catch the wind. The anchored warships thundered a salute, to which the Vasa fired a proud reply, and as she emerged from her drifting cloud of gun-smoke, with the water churned to foam beneath her bow, she made a more majestic spectacle than the citizens had ever seen. All her gun-ports stood open, and the muzzles of her cannon showed through them. Then, as the wind freshened, there came a sudden squall. The great ship made a strange movement and began to list to one side, her ballast shifting with her. The officer in charge ordered the cannon to be heaved across to right her, but the angle of the decks only steepened. The lower gun-ports, still open, dipped below the surface, and the sea poured in. In that first glorious hour, the mighty Vasa, which had been built to rule the Baltic, went down in the harbor of her birth, her flags still flying. There she lay on the seabed for nearly three and a half centuries, until her discovery in 1956 restored her to the world.

grammar_points.name: 过去完成时(had + 过去分词)
with 复合结构/独立主格
be intended to do / order sth to do

stage5.stem: "The king ___ dictated the ship's size before work began."(过去完成时,比‘开始’更早的过去,填与过去分词搭配的助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 动工之前,国王早已规定了这船的尺寸。

stage5.stem: "They ___ laboured for three years before she was launched."(过去完成时,填与过去分词搭配的助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 下水之前,他们已辛苦造了三年。

stage5.stem: "By 1956 the wreck ___ lain on the seabed for centuries."(过去完成时,填与过去分词搭配的助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 到1956年,这艘沉船已在海底躺了几个世纪。

stage5.stem: "The Vasa was more richly carved ___ any previous ship."(‘比…都’,比较级后接的那个连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 瓦萨号比以往任何船都雕饰得更华丽。

stage5.stem: "She was more magnificent than ___ other ship in the fleet."(‘比其他任何一艘都’,填表‘任何’的词)
stage5.stem_cn: 她比舰队里其他任何一艘都更壮观。

stage5.stem: "No ship was ___ splendid than the royal flagship."(‘没有比…更…’,比较级表最高级,填 splendid 前那个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 没有哪艘船比这皇家旗舰更华丽。

stage5.stem: "The Vasa sank ___ all her flags flying."(‘随着…’的独立结构,句中那个介词,与后面名词+现在分词搭配)
stage5.stem_cn: 瓦萨号沉没时,所有旗帜仍在飘扬。

stage5.stem: "She emerged from the smoke, with the water ___ to foam beneath her bow."(with + 名词 + 分词的独立结构,被动‘被搅成’,填‘搅动’那个动词的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 她驶出烟雾,船首下的水被搅成了白沫。

stage5.stem: "The ship listed, with the crew ___ across the deck."(with + 名词 + 分词的独立结构,主动‘滑动’,填‘滑’那个动词的现在分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 船倾侧了,水手们在甲板上滑向一侧。

stage5.stem: "As the wind freshened, there ___ a sudden squall."(there + 动词 倒装,一般过去时‘来了’,填 come 的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 风势转急,突然来了一阵飑。

stage5.stem: "There ___ at the bottom of the harbor a mighty warship."(there + 动词 倒装,‘躺着’,填 lie 的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 港底躺着一艘威武的战舰。

stage5.stem: "There ___ a great cheer as the ship began to move."(there + 动词 倒装,‘响起’,填 rise 的过去式)
stage5.stem_cn: 船开始移动时,爆发出一阵欢呼。

stage5.stem: "The Vasa was intended ___ play a leading role in the fleet."(be intended + 不定式,‘打算用来…’,填不定式符号)
stage5.stem_cn: 瓦萨号本打算在舰队中担当要角。

stage5.stem: "The officer ordered the cannon ___ be heaved across."(order sth + 不定式(被动),填不定式符号)
stage5.stem_cn: 军官下令把大炮搬向另一侧。

stage5.stem: "The king wanted the ship ___ be the finest in Europe."(want sth + 不定式,填不定式符号)
stage5.stem_cn: 国王想让这船成为全欧洲最好的。

stage5.stem: "A large sailing warship of past centuries is a ___."(“大帆船”用哪个词)
"A sudden violent gust of wind, often with rain, is a ___."(“飑,狂风”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 突然而猛烈、常带雨的一阵风。

stage5.stem: "The chief ship carrying the commander of a fleet is the ___."(“旗舰”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 载着舰队司令的主力舰。
